extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots digitised: Figure 1a–e and Figure 8c. Figures 2–7 and other panels of Figure 8 are characterisation/preparation plots and were skipped. For the re-usability plot Figure 1e, only the first and last cycle for each series were extracted according to the stability-plot rule. Figure 1c GHSV x-values used the exact values stated in Experimental section 2.3 (9000, 15000, 21000, 30000, 48000 cm3 h-1 gcat-1), corresponding to the plotted positions on the axis labelled in 10^3 cm3 h-1 gcat-1.
